name: ai-audit-mandate
description: A due-diligence and remediation mandate for software that no human reviews

scripts.build: npm run catalogue && npm run docs && npm run manifest
scripts.verify: node scripts/build-catalogue.mjs --check && node scripts/build-check-index.mjs --check && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs --check
scripts.schema: node scripts/check-finding-shape.mjs --file templates/finding-record.json && node scripts/check-finding-shape.mjs --expect-invalid --dir templates/invalid-fixtures
scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run links && npm run release && npm run schema && npm run lint
